segments.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: חִיֵּיב כָּאן וְחִיֵּיב בְּפִקָּדוֹן כּוּ׳.
segments.en: § The Gemara proceeds to cite the opinion cited last in the baraita explaining the source of the halakha that one is liable for taking a false oath of testimony only for a case involving monetary matters. «Rabbi Shimon says:» The Torah «rendered» one «liable» if he takes a false oath «here,» with regard to an oath of testimony, «and» the Torah «rendered» one «liable» if he takes a false oath «with regard to» an oath on «a deposit;» just as there, the verse is speaking of liability only in cases involving monetary claims, so too here, the verse is speaking of liability only in cases involving monetary claims.
